name: limits
description: OverCrow's fields hold what a note may: a title of 96 bytes (48 two-byte letters of 60 typed), a text of 8192 bytes (of 9000 typed), an entry of 256 bytes (of 300 typed); the rest is not taken. A long text wraps in its field, which grows to ten rows. Eight notes: the add button takes no click. A checklist of 64 entries scrolls in the panel, above Save and Cancel; it has no empty row and says it is full.
